explanation: A newborn panda is pink, almost hairless and only about a thousandth of its mother's weight, so a cub could sit in the palm of your hand.

claims.text: A newborn giant panda cub typically weighs about 100 g.
A typical newborn human baby weighs about 3.3 kg.
A newborn giant panda weighs about a thousandth of its mother's weight.
Newborn giant pandas are pink and almost hairless.
